tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything. Ink is true black; Graphite is a softer charcoal; Paper is a warm off-white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the problem card, panels and the app bar sitting on canvas.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips at rest, code and solution blocks, anything inset in a surface.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for rows, chips and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card edges, dividers, table rules. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (inputs, outline buttons, unselected chips). 3:1 or better on canvas, surface and surface-raised in every theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and math on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, descriptions and labels on canvas, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, helper text, placeholders. On canvas and surface only, not on surface-hover.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and selected chip, the one loudest element on a screen.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill on hover and press.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on action and action-hover.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus ring offset 2px; at least 3:1 on every surface in all themes.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Text, icon and border for a Correct result. Blue on the Okabe-Ito axis so it never relies on red versus green; always paired with the word and a check icon.

tokens.name: correct-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Correct result banner; correct text reads on it.

tokens.name: incorrect
tokens.usage: Text, icon and border for an Incorrect result. Orange, always paired with the word and a cross icon.

tokens.name: incorrect-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Incorrect result banner; incorrect text reads on it.

tokens.name: invalid
tokens.usage: Text, icon and border for an Invalid expression result. Amber, always paired with the words and a warning icon.

tokens.name: invalid-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the Invalid expression banner; invalid text reads on it.

families.math: "KaTeX_Main", "Latin Modern Math", "STIX Two Math", "Cambria Math", serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Landing hero only. One per page.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers on the landing page and login.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Page titles inside the app: Dashboard, History, Profile.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs, problem instructions such as Calculate.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows: topic, difficulty, step numbers. Set text-transform uppercase.

styles.name: answer-input
styles.usage: Text typed into the answer field: 3pi, sqrt(3), pi/4 + 2.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline syntax hints and accepted-notation lists.

styles.name: math-problem
styles.usage: The problem expression, rendered with KaTeX display mode.

styles.name: math-solution
styles.usage: Final answer and solution step expressions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, tight chip internals.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, list row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap, small card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, group gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large card padding, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between page sections inside the app.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between landing page sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom space.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags, keyboard hints, step number badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons, chips.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, solution blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The problem card and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill buttons, difficulty dots, status tags.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. On dark themes depth comes from a hairline, not a blur.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The problem card and hero product frame, the only lifted surfaces.
